name: UCI Credit Approval Dataset
description: The UCI Credit Approval Dataset is a widely studied tabular classification dataset consisting of 690 credit card application instances with 15 mixed continuous and categorical attributes, anonymized to protect personal financial privacy.

verification.notes: Verified against UCI Machine Learning Repository record and DataCite DOI (10.24432/C5FS30). Exactly 690 instances, 15 anonymized attributes (6 numerical, 9 categorical), 37 instances containing missing values, and binary approval outcome (307 positive, 383 negative).
